title: Split Boreal V1 audit follow-up into three gated sprints
context: The audit is useful but was static; live checks found some findings already covered by closed Sprint 08/10/11 work and other findings still present in current code or command registry.
decision: Create a focused V1.1 correctness/security sprint first, then a CLI lifecycle/product command sprint, then a V2 storage and collaboration design sprint. Mark only the verified V1.1 leaf tasks ready now.
consequences: Avoids duplicating already closed generated-cache, schema parity, canonical rebuild, and package-smoke work.
Keeps immediately claimable work limited to live correctness and local-security gaps.
